article.title: Etats-Unis - Chine : le clash des superpuissances
article.text: En 2017, le président Trump promet de "faire payer la Chine" et bouleverse les relations entre les Etats-Unis et Pékin. Le gouvernement de Xi Jinping place de grands espoirs dans son successeur, Joe Biden, mais ceux-ci sont anéantis par une rencontre glaciale en Alaska. La visite de la présidente de la Chambre des représentants Nancy Pelosi à Taïwan rapproche plus que jamais les deux superpuissances d'une confrontation militaire. Face à un Washington de plus en plus hostile, Xi Jinping entend restaurer la puissance chinoise. Alors que le retour de Donald Trump ouvre une nouvelle phase d'incertitude qui commence par sa guerre du droit de douane, hauts responsables américains, proches du pouvoir chinois et acteurs internationaux racontent les confrontations des dirigeants des deux pays les plus puissants au monde.

plan.visionAnalysis: The photograph shows two men in dark suits shaking hands in front of alternating flags of the United States and China. The setting is formal and neutral, with a dark blue curtain in the background. The handshake gesture is central, symbolizing diplomatic interaction or confrontation. The lighting is even and clear, emphasizing the figures and their interaction. This is a real-world diplomatic meeting image, not a logo or illustration.
articleFacts: In 2017, President Trump vowed to take a tough stance on China, disrupting US-China relations.
The Chinese government hoped for better relations under Joe Biden, but the Alaska meeting was cold and tense.
Nancy Pelosi's visit to Taiwan increased tensions between the US and China, pushing them closer to military confrontation.
Xi Jinping aims to restore Chinese power amid growing hostility from Washington.
The return of Donald Trump introduces new uncertainty, including renewed trade war measures.
The article discusses confrontations and power struggles between the two global superpowers, the US and China.
plan.storyPremise: The story visualizes the escalating tensions and confrontations between the US and China from 2017 onwards, highlighting diplomatic clashes, power struggles, and looming military threats. The protagonist embodies a diplomatic mediator caught amidst these superpower conflicts, witnessing the fragile and hostile interactions that define this era.
plan.fictionBoundary: The semantic stream entries referencing the European Union (Italy, member states, France) are unrelated to the US-China conflict and do not influence the story's visual or narrative elements. The painted scenes will focus solely on the US-China power struggle and diplomatic tensions, avoiding any unrelated European Union symbolism or themes.
